tasks.title: Analyze VA motion space distributions
tasks.description: Collect statistics from real driving videos to understand VA's expression/pose space distributions
tasks.details: Create a script to process pipeline2.py outputs with real driving videos and collect mean/std of target_pose_embed and target_theta values. This will establish the expected ranges for VA warping.

tasks.title: Normalize VASA outputs to VA space
tasks.description: Update vasa_va_bridge.py to normalize VASA's expression and pose outputs to match VA's expected distributions
tasks.details: Implement normalization functions that transform VASA's expression_embed and theta values to match the mean/std collected from VA's real driving videos. This will prevent out-of-distribution warping artifacts.

tasks.title: Implement temporal smoothing
tasks.description: Add temporal smoothing to VASA motion outputs to eliminate jitter
tasks.details: Implement exponential moving average (EMA) smoothing for theta and expression values. Use alpha=0.7 for pose and alpha=0.9 for expressions. Also implement the config's smooth_window:5 using convolution.

tasks.title: Fix masking thresholds and compositing
tasks.description: Increase face mask threshold from 0.6 to 0.8 and enable modnet_mask for better compositing
tasks.details: Update face_idt.forward threshold to 0.8 to prevent green glow artifacts. Enable modnet_mask=True in bridge for better edge handling. Test with different backgrounds to verify leak prevention.

tasks.title: Implement 3-avatar visualization
tasks.description: Create visualization showing source/identity, driving proxy, and target frames side-by-side like pipeline2.py
tasks.details: Modify vasa_va_bridge.py to generate 3 columns: (1) static source identity, (2) neutral face with VASA motion as driving proxy, (3) final warped result. Concatenate horizontally for debugging and quality assessment.
